regions.today: There will be a mix of cloud and sunny spells this evening, with a few patches of light rain and drizzle, mainly in southern parts of the province. Winds will be light or moderate and southeasterly.
regions.tonight: There will be patchy outbreaks of rain and drizzle across the east and south of Leinster tonight, but staying mostly dry elsewhere with some clear spells and a few patches of fog and grass frost. Lowest temperatures will range from 0 to 7 degrees, coldest in the west of the province, in light to moderate southeasterly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Dry for much of tomorrow, with some sunny spells and just isolated showers in the morning and afternoon. Cloud will increase in the evening and outbreaks of rain will develop in the west of the province towards nightfall. Highest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees in light to moderate southeasterly winds.
